objective.weights: per scenario; zero-weight shapes outside decision scope
objective.decision: PROMOTE iff active shapes all pass regression bound and weighted geomean >=1.15; else REJECT; unknown never promotes

oracle: Epoch001 affine CPU float64 exact oracle; reduction exact binary fraction CPU float64 row sums
lease: fresh idle query before each official cell; monitor every 100ms and at boundaries; foreign PID quarantines cell
baseline: B0 independent full rerun, B1 real CHIA tag/cache with inherited protocol hashing, B2 bundle+typed fixed cache, B3 B2 with largest weighted shape first and safe early reject, FULL_A resolved evidence scope plus decision-impact/cost ordering and safe early reject
seed: Epoch001 B0 actual paired 61-sample corpus; historical raw timing evidence reused only under matching typed dependencies, sampler equivalence and environment. Temporal stationarity is a development assumption checked against fresh B0, not an independent lease proof.
cost: CUDA event summed durations of timed paired batches only; excludes compilation/oracle/warmup. Live launches and subprocess wall measured separately. Reuse contributes zero new sampled GPU seconds. No replay charged as live.
